title: Scripture and Worship
definition: Scripture and worship belong together because God's Word reveals who He is, what He has done, and how His people are to honor Him.
summary: True worship is shaped by the truth God has revealed in His Word.
christFocus: Jesus makes true worship possible and teaches His people to worship the Father in spirit and truth.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture fuels worship by revealing God's glory, holiness, grace, justice, wisdom, and saving work. Worship without truth becomes shallow or misdirected.

The Word shapes the songs, prayers, preaching, ordinances, obedience, and whole-life devotion of God's people. True worship responds to God as He has revealed Himself.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Worship can easily become driven by preference, emotion, performance, or tradition. Scripture and worship matters because God defines worship, not human taste.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Let Scripture shape your worship privately and with the Church. Sing, pray, listen, obey, and serve in ways that respond to God's revealed truth.
